descriptionChirho: A member of the nation of Israel (Ἰσραηλείτης), used as a noun of ethnic/national identity in both vocative address ('Men, Israelites!' in Acts 2:22, 3:12, 5:35, 13:16, 21:28) and nominative/predicate use ('a true Israelite' in John 1:47; 'Israelites' in Rom 9:4, 11:1; 2 Cor 11:22). All three clusters represent the same referent with identical multilingual signatures: eng 'Israelite(s)', spa 'israelita(s)', hin इस्राएली, arb إِسْرَائِيلِيُّونَ/إِسْرَائِيلِيٌّ, kor 이스라엘 사람, swa 'Waisraeli/Mwisraeli'. The vocative (S69550, S69553) vs nominative (S69551) distinction is purely grammatical, not semantic.
